chat: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the chest skin lesion in detail, including its color, size, texture, and whether it's painful or itchy? Also, how long has it been there, and have you noticed any changes over time?

I noticed this spot on my chest about two months ago, and it has definitely gotten larger since then. It looks like a dark, uneven patch that feels a bit rough to the touch, but I haven't felt any pain or itching. Aside from growing, I haven't noticed any other changes like bleeding or crusting.

Does the lesion appear raised or flat, and have you experienced any fever, night sweats, or recent weight loss? Also, do you have a history of skin cancer, frequent sun exposure, or a family history of similar skin conditions?

The lesion feels mostly flat with some slightly raised, irregular edges. I haven't had any fevers, night sweats, or weight loss recently. I do spend a lot of time outdoors, but I have no history of skin cancer in my family or myself.
Have you experienced any recent trauma to the area, or do you have a history of autoimmune conditions or recent infections? Additionally, has the lesion bled, ulcerated, or produced any discharge?
No, I haven't had any trauma, autoimmune issues, or recent infections that I'm aware of. The spot also hasn't bled, ulcerated, or produced any discharge at all.

Do you have a history of smoking or exposure to industrial chemicals, and have you noticed any lumps or swelling in your neck or underarms? Also, has the lesion changed in appearance since you first noticed it, and do you have any shortness of breath or persistent cough?

Yes, I smoke a pack of cigarettes a day and have for the last forty years, but I haven't noticed any lumps in my neck or underarms. The lesion has definitely grown in size since I first saw it, though its dark, uneven look remains the same. I don't have any shortness of breath or a persistent cough either.
